entries.title: Jeremiah 2:2
segments: Thy youth--thine espousals; the youth of the nation, when God espoused it to himself by entering into covenant with it.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:3
segments:
First-fruits; the first nation consecrated to God's service, and the first generation of that nation after the establishment of the covenant at Sinai. 
 
  Increase; harvest or ingathering of believers.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:5
segments: The conduct of backsliders greatly dishonors God; it is a virtual declaration before the world that they have tried his service, and found it hard and unreasonable.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:6
segments:
vv 6-7. 
 
The beginning of departure from God is ingratitude and forgetfulness of he mercies; where the remembrance of these is warm and fresh in the soul, it keeps us near to God, and makes communion with him exceedingly sweet and precious.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:8
segments: Pastors; shepherds of the people; that is, rulers, whose duty it was both to obey God's law, and require obedience in others.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:10
segments: Chittim; to the west; see note on

. 
 
  Kedar; on the east, in Arabia.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:11
segments: The constancy of the heathen in serving their idols is a standing rebuke of the inconstancy of many worshippers if the living and true God.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:13
segments: God is the eternal and uncreated fountain of good; upon all who cleave to him he bestows life and strength and blessedness; but every device of those who forsake him, and put their confidence in earthly objects, is only a broken cistern that can hold no water, and its end must be disappointment and misery.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:14
segments: Is Israel a servant?--why is he spoiled? since Israel is God's first-born son,
, why is he spoiled as if he were a slave?

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:15
segments: Young lions; the northern enemies.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:16
segments: Noph--Tahapanes; cities of Egypt.  The Egyptians join with the northern invaders in destroying Judah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:18
segments: Sihor; the Nile.
The river; the Euphrates.  Drinking the water of these rivers seems to denote the vain efforts of the Jews to obtain help first from one, then from the other of these nations.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:20
segments: Playing the harlot; by serving false gods, which the prophets everywhere regard as spiritual fornication.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:21
segments: The tendency of the human race to degeneracy is a sad and humiliating proof of its fallen condition; so strong is this downward current in families and nations, that nothing but God's grace can preserve them from utter corruption and ruin.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:22
segments:
Wash thee; endeavor to hide thy guilt. 
 
  Nitre; not our nitre, but a mineral substance used anciently as now for soap. 
 
The vain endeavors of sinners to justify themselves, fail to satisfy either their own consciences or the judgment of their fellow sinners; how much more the judgment of God, who knoweth all things.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:23
segments: The valley; the valley of Hinnom, where the idolatrous Jews sacrificed their children to Moloch.
Traversing her ways; running hither and thither in her wantonness.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:24
segments: At her pleasure; in the excitement of her desire.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:25
segments:
Withhold thy foot--thy throat from thirst; do not wear out thy sandals and make thyself thirsty in the pursuit of false gods. 
 
  There is no hope; my case is desperate, and I must seek the help of idols.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:27
segments:
vv 27-28. 
 
They who forget God in prosperity, and call upon him only in adversity, have no true love for him, and connot expect deliverance.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:30
segments: When a nation persecutes and destroys the messengers by whom God calls it to repentance, the measure of its iniquity is full, and it is near destruction.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:31
segments:
We are lords; or, "we are free" to go where we please. 
 
  Unto thee; unto Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:33
segments:
Trimmest--thy way; usest subtle artifices. 
 
  Taught the wicked ones; the wicked women.  Jerusalem has become a leader in idolatry.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:34
segments:
Blood of--the poorest innocents; she has added murder to idolatry. "The poor innocents" are not merely the children sacrificed to Moloch, but the righteous poor whom she has slain. 
 
  Upon all these; probably, in open view, upon all thy skirts, to which God points as it were with the finger.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:35
segments: The self-delusion of sinners has no limits; it leads bold and shameless transgressors to deny their guilt, and persuade themselves that God is not angry with them and will not punish them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:36
segments: Gaddest thou about--to change thy way; wanderest every way in search of idolatrous alliances.

entries.title: Jeremiah 2:37
segments: Thy hands upon thy head; a posture expressive of grief.
When God is against a people for their sins, their earthly confidences turn to their destruction.
